steps.name: Back to Glaston
steps.objective: After talking to [Lena] in “Nidaros,” talk to [Leticia] in the “Street North of the Square.” Then report the quest to [Leticia].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ms. Lena?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Huh? ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you thinking?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's no big deal... . Are you ready to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's already time like this. It's a shame that I wasn't able to enjoy Ash Wave properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You enjoyed it so much that Embla asked you to stop and go.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It was a precious time for me as a member of the Empire to build a friendly relationship with Nidaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Priest Askren, who was supposed to see me off, said he couldn't wake up with a hangover because of Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: With just that much... ? Hmm… Did I tell you to stop talking about the priest and go to the angel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I quietly visited and greeted you early in the morning.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, should I have told you earlier? There was one thing I wanted to ask the angel... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The villagers said they thought they saw a ‘noble young man with sharp eyes’. That man was not the Lord Müller I was looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, then who is it… ? Or rather, what's going on with Lord Müller?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know exactly. However, his whereabouts were unknown, so I was looking into every place he went to carry out his mission.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I didn't find anything here either. I was going to ask the angel if he knew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find out. Please wait a moment. Uh, Lena?
(Lena reaches out and grabs %s's arm.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll just take your heart. There's already a lot of work to do, but I don't want to leave you with this kind of work.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Don't worry. It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Lena says so... All right.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding. Oh, I forgot to mention that.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I sent a letter to the Imperial Palace saying the work was over. When we arrive at Glaston, we will have to see His Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'd like to meet you in person and tell you.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay. Well then, let's go back to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, %s, Sir Lena. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, how are you?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Nothing much happened in Glaston, right?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It was a little busy, but nothing major happened. Did you two successfully complete your mission?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I finished it safely.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank goodness. Although I’m very curious about what’s going on! I won't ask. Secret missions shine only when they are kept secret.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hoo.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I like this guy.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, I like Lord Lena too.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll invite you to my house later.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, is this real? Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, when will you go to see His Majesty?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Could you wait here for a moment? It won't take long. I'll go to the government office.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I finished my work today. Would you like to wait and chat while Lord Lena comes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Then let's go.

steps.name: shadow of despair
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Leticia] in the “Street North of the Square” and use the portal in front to go see [Kaina]. And after talking with [Kaina], go to the “Oracle’s Room” in “Sanctuary Eidos.” 
2 When the situation is over, report the quest to [Iris] in the “Oracle’s Room.”

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: After Glaston returned to normal, government offices became busy. The Magic Agency, with its unpleasant wizards, deserved to be shut down.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There are nobles in the council who took Chairman Aaron's side. Those people before, according to the Chairman, were as loyal as a freeling who bowed down and stuck out his belly.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: However, since there is no one named Aaron, the position of chairman has been vacant for a long time and they are now deciding who will take over.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The funny thing is, you get to see different people do it. According to rumors, the imperial family found a lot of corruption among nobles this time, so I guess that's why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, so that happened.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's not Glaston's work, but the Imperial Castle recently decided to reorganize magic-related institutions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean the magic academy and the wise man’s tower?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. Due to the reorganization of the Magic Agency, the Tower of the Wise was temporarily closed, and Magic Academy Zerenis was ordered to temporarily close.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Still, it must have felt like it was a vacation at Magic Academy Zerenis because the order was lifted, but it was said that the Tower of the Wise took longer than expected.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't know the details either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even though I don't know much, I know quite a lot.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I heard it while patrolling the administrative district, and I also heard it directly from Sylvia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . Is Glaston okay now?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It has to be okay. If it's not okay, I'll do something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel relieved to hear that.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: So %s, stay strong too. Since you have done well so far, you will continue to do well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe. Hey, here comes Lord Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I waited a long time. I guess I have to go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leti, I'll go now. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Leticia, see you later,

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Goodbye, you two!

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Your Majesty… .
(Kaina greets the two with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm glad you came back safely.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I was planning to visit you at the Imperial Castle, but I didn't know you would be here.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I thought the two of you would come soon, so I came out first despite Argent's dissuasion.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty, it is okay for you to come out of the Imperial Palace into the square or administrative district... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It is dangerous to go out into the open sea without saying anything.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh my, Argent. How did you know that?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He may have moved while hiding his identity, but there were still too many traces left so I couldn't pretend not to know.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I did it because there was a place I really wanted to go.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We'll hear about that later.
(Kaina turns her gaze towards Lena and Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: So can you tell me what happened in Nidaros?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Report to Kaina about what happened in Nidaros.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Awakening the 'wings' of ancient ruins and trying to destroy the world by colliding with other ancient ruins... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Anyway, thank you for your hard work, you two… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Compared to %s, I didn't play a big role.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Lord Lena helped me a lot.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Daphne's actions are difficult to understand, but they must have some meaning.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: In order to protect his child, he will kill Aaron and even kill God... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It doesn't seem like it will threaten the empire right away, but we need to think about ways to deal with it.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, thank you for your hard work. There was so much work that I couldn't even rest properly... . Take a few days off and then go find Sir Müller.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I will ask Lord Lena's superiors for their understanding.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If my skills had been better, I would have been able to find out his whereabouts... . I'm sorry I didn't find out anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your Majesty knew, too. It would be even weirder not to know.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, if I have a favor to ask you later, I will contact you separately.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I understand, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My Majesty... . Have you seen any other predictions recently?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I saw it, but it's all little things.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The young man who manages the square gives flowers to his lover, or Sylvia goes to see the performance of Papanstar Daisy... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'll let you know later if I see something important or miss something. then… What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to discuss it with Iris.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I would like to thank %s again. Because you solved what the empire had been unable to do so far.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now I'm going to clean up the Ministry of Magic and reestablish what magic means in the Empire.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It will take a long time to wash away the sins committed by foolish people... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That is the ‘atonement’ that the Empire can make for the Continent of Freios… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And I think it is a necessary step in order to live together with others.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The time has already come. I must now leave, as I have a meeting with the nobles of the Council.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty. See you next time.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You two, please return safely. Your Majesty, let’s go.
(Lena and Adventurer bow their heads and see Kaina off.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: From now on, both Your Majesty and the Empire will have increasingly busy days... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Are you going to meet the goddess now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it should be. What about Lena?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Your Majesty has given an order, so you should go back and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later then. Take a good rest.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Good job.
(Gateway to Eidos. As the oracle room approaches, Adventurer's steps stop by themselves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling? Something is strange... .
(I look around, but all I see is the scenery of Eidos I've always seen when I come to meet Iris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it an illusion? Phew… . Okay, then let's go in.
(The moment Adventurer takes a step towards the oracle room, someone who was watching him from afar slowly appears.)

lines.speaker: 거울을 든 여성
lines.text: Maybe it's because it's the Adventurer of a goddess, but I have a good feeling about it. Hehe, enjoy your meeting with Barbatos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (W-what is it? It's the oracle's room I always see, but why does it have such an ominous vibe...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris! Iris!
(When the curtain that blocks the view is lifted, not the smiling Iris as always, but the person who always sneers at Adventurer appears.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I've been waiting, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos? Wait, Iris… Where is Iris?!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I'm here to talk... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you do with Iris?!
(Barvatos lightly shakes off the attack of %s, who runs towards him angrily.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It looks like you have no intention of listening to my story. The goddess is in her place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can you believe that?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You lack faith in God... .
(In an instant, Barbatos' presence disappears, and the subsequent blow blows %s's body into the air.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hey, I don't have much strength... I have to hold on...)
(Barvatos lifts the gunblade and throws it straight at %s's abdomen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow!!
(Barvatos looks down indifferently at Adventurer lying on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Off… Ugh… Barba… Toss… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … Do you still have the strength to struggle? If you had listened to my story from the beginning, this pain could have been avoided... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I have no intention of killing you here. To begin with, you are not a great person who will die easily... It’s not my way to end things like this.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I was going to say that this area is a fake modeled after the oracle room, so it won't cause any harm to the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's all a result of your impatience. Now, just listen to my story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. What on earth are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What do you plan to do with Daphne?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It looks like there is no answer as expected.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You know it too. The fact that it is almost impossible for life, or even beings affected by God's power, to destroy God.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Didn't you personally see the disappearance of El-Larsa, the messenger? That's the way of the world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But… What would you do if that were possible? If there is someone who knows a method that does not make sense in the world and can deal with it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that Daphne... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: In the meantime, Daphne killed many witches and accumulated power, saying she was doing it for 'her child'.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If a person who was originally a monster would openly say that he would kill God... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Goddess Hecate is by no means an easy opponent, but his power may already have surpassed hers.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s. What do you think will happen to the person who kills God? It will never end with just one.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He will fall into an unknown obsession and seek out and kill the few remaining gods.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There were people like that in the past too. I achieved my goal by killing the evil spirit and becoming ‘Deerside’, but I didn’t stop.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Let me ask you. Do you think Daphne will spare the goddess Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. Barbatos... . that… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: So, I would like to make a suggestion. Iris If you don’t want to see the goddess’s end with your own eyes… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Or, conversely, Iris If you don't want to show your death to the Goddess, then be mine.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I promise. Let me show you a better way than now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. It's noisy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't make a suggestion that doesn't sound like it's being said, like you're being generous. An unqualified demon is presumptuous… There's no way he could be a god... . Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Because I’m qualified… . Talking about qualifications... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Good. Your will… Well, I didn't have any expectations from the beginning... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A world destined to perish anyway. All I had to do was choose the one that had the slightest chance, but it ended up being a shame.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: We will prepare a place for you soon. The stage where you and the goddess will face each other's final moments... .
(Barvatos smiles faintly, raises his gunblade and aims it at Adventurer's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My body doesn’t move….)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now let me send it to your goddess.
(With those words, the cold day falls and Adventurer's vision becomes pure white.)
(And the sound of a mirror breaking is heard from somewhere.)
Clink!

steps.name: his steps
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room” and report the quest to [Talos] in “Knossos.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Wow!!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Iris… . are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: First, take a deep breath, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . uh? I was definitely talking to Barbatos a little while ago... … .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The strange energy felt in front of the oracle room could not have been... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Iris about your encounter with Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Wait a minute… .
(Iris puts his hands together, closes his eyes and prays. Then, small lights flutter from the sky and fill the space.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You should be fine now that you have purified the entire Eidos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Although Barbatos said it was 'fake', it felt like the oracle room... It was creepy.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you know this space, it wouldn't be a lie to say that it was God. I was waiting in the same space... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But it wouldn't have been possible alone. Even for a god, it is never easy to completely control an empty space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I survived without being hurt after being attacked like that may have been due to the strength of the helper next to Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's right. This could be due to the fact that I couldn't hear %s's voice in Nidaros.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Sometimes I see a 'flow' between the cracks in the great wall. I call it the spirit of destruction directed at Etoire... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This energy, a mixture of various evil intentions, sometimes takes shape as a specific person... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I could see them from the closest place. Daphne and Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even now, two witches have lost their lives and their powers taken away by Daphne.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And Barbatos is revealing his destination as if he's doing it on purpose... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Nidaros, Knossos, and even the place where the Tower of Wise Men is located.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if you think you came to Nidaros because of Daphne, why did you come to Knossos and the Tower of the Wise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that he is chasing Daphne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to hurry.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Is it okay if I go without stopping?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. No problem.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I understand. I will soon be able to finish some of the tidying up of the great wall. Just hold on until then. sorry. I'll follow along in a moment.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And don't worry too much if you can't hear my voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go to Knossos and check. Talos might know something about ‘Deerside’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I'll be back. See you later.

steps.name: looking for clues
steps.objective: Talk to [Talos] in “Knossos” and report the quest to [Notos] in “Nereis Gate.”

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I thought I would see you soon, but here I am. Even though I treated him so badly, he came and cleaned hard.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I'm clean, so in return, I'll tell you what you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know what it is.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Just sit here quietly and listen. Do you need a snack?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay. Just keep saying what you were saying.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As you may have guessed, I am not actually Talos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we call him Daedalus?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Call me whatever you feel comfortable with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ha, I've been traveling for a while and I've developed a knack for teasing people.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay. I'm going to talk like this, but which one would you like to hear first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: In the days of chaotic skies, numerous powers were fighting for supremacy on the continent.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Until then, we didn't pay any attention to what people outside of Creed were doing. I thought they just didn't engage with each other.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Without realizing that such an attitude increasingly isolated us, we were attacked by humans.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They attacked Creed's forest, saying they had to protect themselves from dirty, greedy, and cruel beastmen.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Clearly they wanted something, and we spent anxious days not knowing what it was.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Then one day, a wizard from Sylvaria came and asked to speak with King Minos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: King Minos tried to get information from him and kill him, but he changed his mind because he liked the wizard... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zelenis… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes, Zelenis. We decided to cooperate with each other... Everything went wrong because of Talos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm….)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: At that time, Talos and I were like priests protecting Creed's forest. Although he was only a vain priest in a godless world, he was still looking for a way to fight against the onslaught of humans.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Then, I heard that there was a being like an incarnation in the southwestern sea, so I went to see it. Glaucus, meeting him didn't change Creed's condition.

lines.speaker: 탈로스

lines.text: I've never seen anyone like that. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So are you a traveler?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I think %s is correct. A traveler. ring. Because villagers don't carry weapons like that. ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It was a lamp filled with the flame of resentment and a sharp ice sword. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was a weapon… ? Two of those too?
Growling─.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry. ring. I have no strength. Let’s go to Devesis quickly. ring.
(Contrary to what he said, Juri Ling leaps powerfully and rides on %s’s back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's nice to go together, but does it really have to be like this?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry. ring. Let's go quickly. ring. Otherwise I can’t support you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You have to chase down the remaining monsters as you go. ring. Haam… … . Just take the path where you can see the tower. ring. Haam.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . I can't help it. I have no choice but to just go.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Cheer up. ring. I'll think about what to eat as I go. ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Haaaam… .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Kuul… … … . Kuuul… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juri ring? Juri ring! What if I leave everything to you and go to sleep?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Couuuuul… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was going to ask for guidance, but I can't believe I've already fallen into a deep sleep. If I do this, it’s like I’m going there alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, should I just leave it alone?

steps.name: village in the clouds
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Shuvier] in “Devesis” and check the situation in front of [Patello]. 
2. Select [Sage's Tower Description] from NPC [Patello]'s chat menu, and then report the quest to [Patello] in 「Devesis」.

lines.text: Twinkle jewels, breaking beautifully♬
(At the entrance to Devesis Village, a figure with beautiful, long blonde hair sits on a bench and hums a strange song.)
Even in Eastland and Freios♩
Shining jewels, I'm here to smash them ♪
Hehe, then shall we look for someone useful?
(At that time, an unfamiliar traveler can be seen walking along the road outside, looking around the scenery of the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Devesis. It looks like the tower with the wizard's hat inside is the Tower of the Wise Man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See the rocks sparkling here and there? Does it have some magic power? It doesn't seem to be a gem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a nicer place than I thought. Uh, are you hungry? Now that I think about it, I think I'm hungry too.
Who is that person talking to? Uh, what is it? Sniff. It also smells like precious jewels.
Hey, wait a minute!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
Ugh, it's slipping!
Boom!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm surprised. ring. Is this person dead? ring. I fell and can't get up. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?
It's not okay... . I'm so embarrassed that I just can't get up. Wake me up… .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I know this person. ring. This is someone I hate. ring. I want jewels. ring.
(Adventurer lifts up the fallen person and checks his condition.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There doesn't seem to be any injury... . But why?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm a person whose job is to smash jewels. ring.
I've been waiting for someone like you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
My name is Shubie! Twinkle Jewel☆Star left her hometown and came to Playos in search of jewels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you from Eastland? Are you Lu Man?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Yeah. In Luman. But how do you know Lu Man? The people of Freios don't know anything about Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… I know someone at Luman.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Who? Who, who?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jiscard, Yuran, Ul, El, Ren, and the other people in the union.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow, who the hell are you? How do you know them all?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My introduction is late. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Eh? to? Wow! I heard that name. I heard you met the goddess and went to heaven!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, have you gone to heaven? ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I had gone to heaven, I wouldn't have been able to come here.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehehe. It's so nice to have a hero like that come to Devesis. %s, will you be my guarantor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guarantor? What warranty? sorry. I have some work to do, so I'll decline.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Well, I can't help it. I have no choice but to wait for someone else.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: By the way, are you holding any rare jewels or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.
(Juriring glares at Shuvier, clutching the jewel he is holding tightly.)

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Yeah? weird. I smelled a precious gem somewhere and thought it was %s. I'm good at smelling jewels. I guess it's just my mood this time.
Growling─.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Oh, I'm hungry. If you go a little further, there is a large restaurant. Eat there. There are lots of delicious menu items.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I was already about to go there. ring. Ugh, I'm hungry. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Schubie.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hehe, if you change your mind midway, tell me. I'll be waiting. You're welcome anytime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later if you get a chance.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Hello, goodbye.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: It's fascinating. Here, I met everyone who knew about Lu Man’s situation. Uh, what is this?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Is it a gem? Oh, no. It looks like snake scales... .
Growling─.
It hasn’t been long since I ate, but I’m hungry again.
(A man stretches lightly and looks at the tower standing in the distance.)
I understand that the Wise Man's Tower is being closed due to issues with the Ministry of Magic, but how long will this continue? .
Grumble ─.
That sounds incredible. It's not my boat? Ah, it's him. Uh, what is it? That person… .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Just go a little further. ring. The place in front of you is a restaurant. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can't you just walk?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry. ring.
Hey, you, wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
Who are you? I feel an incredibly strong magical power... .
(A startled Juri Ring hurriedly gets off %s's back.)
Oh, is it an illusion? Magical power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be because of Juri Ring...? Then where...)
(Adventurer places his hand on Juri Ling’s head.)
What are you? You have no intention of hiding your enormous magical power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like that.
You said it wasn't like that, but your magic power disappeared again? What on earth are you doing? This kind of magical power is rare even among wizards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are a wizard. I feel like I'm being misunderstood right now... Let me start by introducing myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A brief introduction is given to the male wizard in front.)
(The man who heard the introduction extends his hand for a handshake.)
Nice to meet you. I am Patelo, a wizard who studies at the Tower of the Wise. Feel free to call me Patello.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I wanted to say thank you when I met you, but I never thought we would run into each other like this.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: You don't know how glad I am that my stubborn, playboy brother has reconciled thanks to you. Phew, they are really bad guys. He didn't even listen to what I said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the situation... .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I know to some extent. Magicians from the Ministry of Magic are plotting evil deeds and threatening Zephyrus with it... .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: So, the next time I see him, I'm going to hang him on the cliff of Bayuna Canyon. While hanging Zephyrus, I have to hang up all the bad guys as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh?!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Don't worry. I've done it a few times before. haha.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: This person seems to have more muscle strength than magic power. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Notos already told me to go to Patelo if I need help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The tower can be seen really well from here. Could you please explain?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: The tower with the wizard hat behind me? That is the ‘Tower of the Wise’ that symbolizes Devesis.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It seems to have been revealed to people around the time of the founding of the Sylvaria Empire, but looking at the records, it seems to have existed even before that.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It is still a mystery how such a striking tower went undiscovered for so long.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It is said that a long time ago, a wise old man lived alone in a tower.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: At some point, there were a lot of people who lost their homes and moved here, so they gave them a place to live here. That is the origin of Devesis.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It is said that the old man taught people many things, including magic, and then left somewhere. The empty tower became a place for wizards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Old man…….)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: If Magic Academy Zerenis taught students with the goal of training wizards, and the Magic Agency wanted to have them use magic for the people of the empire... .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: The Tower of the Wise is an institution that conducts officially approved research to further develop magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Although it is difficult because we have to consistently produce results… If you are a wizard with an aptitude for research, this is a much better fit.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hmm. It feels a bit strange to be outside the tower for this long.

steps.name: at the threshold of the clouds
steps.objective: Talk to [Patello] in “Debesis” and go forward to [Racelis]. After all conversations are over, report the quest to [Racelis].

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I see. It's fate that we met like this, so instead of acting like this on the street, why don't we go to a restaurant and have a meal and talk?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Okay. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I'll eat a lot (because of the jurilling). Will it be okay?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, I don't eat as much as I look. ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's okay. Because I eat a lot.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, go to the restaurant and you'll see what I mean. ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Huh?
(Patello looks up at the sky as if he senses something, then quickly opens the magic book and reaches out toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A monster jewel flew by. ring.
(After a while, the Wise Man's Tower shakes slightly and the sound of a frightened bird running away is heard.)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Sometimes a demon with jewel eyes leaves its nest and flies all the way here. So I scare them and chase them away.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: They're not a big threat, so we don't subdue them like we used to. Still, Peridot is a bit dangerous... .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It seems like the number of flights has increased significantly these days. I'll have to tell this to Teacher Martha later.
Growling─.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Wow, the customer must be very hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this isn't me... .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's okay. Being hungry is not a sin. Let's go. To the ‘threshold of the clouds’.
Welcome, sir.
(A woman dressed neatly as a chef greets the group entering the restaurant with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.
I'll show you where to sit. ah… It’s Mr. Patel again… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Why Patelo?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Ahaha, I hated Chef Lascellis a little.
(The female chef called Lacellis smiles silently and makes eye contact with Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I feel like this is my first time seeing you. Are you traveling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not about traveling, it's about work. This is my first time coming to Devesis, and the atmosphere is really nice.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: It's not because it's my hometown, but the scenery here is beautiful and there are a lot of good people. There are great wizards like Martha... .

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Mr. Patel, are you going out to eat again?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: … I think you ate it two hours ago.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I get hungry so quickly that there is nothing I can do. I came again while serving a guest.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Phew… . Sir, would you like to order?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Is Chef Lascellis taking orders directly?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: The friends who helped me with my work weren't feeling well. I decided to take charge of the hall for a few days.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's because of that 'dream' again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A dream?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: These days, there are a lot of strange dreams among villagers. Those friends also had the same dream and were worried because they were heartbroken.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Last week, I had that dream too, so I had no choice but to rest. Still, I'm glad that I'm feeling better after getting some rest.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: At some point, everyone in the village started having the same dream. It's a dream of stepping on a black carpet and walking forward endlessly, but the atmosphere of the place is different for each person.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's basically a temple-like place, but some people see a clear and clean sky, while others see the place in ruins and covered in snow.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: I dreamed of walking through snow-covered ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Maybe that's why there's even a rumor going around that it's a dream caused by the devil.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: The priests came and investigated, but I don't think they found anything special.
Growling─.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: You must be very hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this isn't me... .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm hungry. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, yes. I'm a little hungry.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: All menu items are delicious, but my recommendation is ‘Blood Sugar Spike Steak’.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Steak is a common dish, but the steak here is special.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: This is because it has a non-irritating sweetness and a subtle spicy taste, as well as Chef Rojian's special sauce that adds richness to the taste.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: For me personally, this dish has a lot of memories. It's a dish I enjoyed eating when I was young, holding my parents' hands. I hope you enjoy it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I would like to ask you for one thing. no. I'll order one more.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Yes, sir. Then I will make it delicious.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef Lascellis, I will order ‘everything’ on this page of the menu.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'll just eat this today and then I'll stop.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Phew… .

steps.name: I'm full. Let's do our thing.
steps.objective:
1. After talking with [Racelis] in 「Thebesis」, go to [Martha]. 
2. After talking with [Marta], defeat the monsters on “Oscar Road” to obtain <Happy Mandrake>. Then return to [Devesis] and report the quest to [Martha].

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow, it's delicious. ring. This is my first time eating such delicious food. ring. I'm full. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's really delicious.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Right? This is why I can't pass the 'cloud threshold'.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Uh, Lascellis… ?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Lasellis is strange again. ring.
(Racelis is standing in the kitchen aisle like a man entranced.)

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Mr. Patel, please eat quickly and go back… . Eat in moderation and go back… . We're running out of ingredients. I’m sick of it… . Because of you, I have nothing left... .

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: This bastard, don’t drink the food you worked so hard to make like water… .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's a common occurrence. It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Now, shall we get to the point? How can I help you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Just tell me what you need. I will help you to the extent that I can. Because I don’t like complicated things either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there any legends related to gods handed down in Devesis?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: %s, I'll eat this. ring.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Oh, is that it?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: This is what Teacher Martha told me… . It is said that Creed's beast entered the Wise Man's Tower, gained enlightenment, and went to a nearby canyon.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: That was when the ‘Sky of Chaos’ was at its peak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Canyon?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I don't know exactly, but they say the place the prisoner entered is now called the [Blind Bird's Nest].

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Teacher Martha once sealed part of the road because she said it was dangerous. If you're going to go, you'll have to tell your teacher.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I should meet Martha and listen to what she has to say.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: You are probably taking a break and having a cup of tea by now. Let’s go after we finish eating. I'll guide you.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Huh? I guess he was very hungry, seeing as he cleared his plate cleanly.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I ate well. ring. It was delicious. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . It's delicious. No, it's delicious. Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Next time you come to the threshold of the clouds, dine in my name. Don't decline. It's my own reward.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Okay, ring. %s, don’t hesitate and come with me again. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry about that... .

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's okay. are you okay. Then let's go now.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Wow, now I can take a breather! Mr. Patel is finally going!!

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Chef Lascellis, isn’t your voice too loud?

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Oh, really? I was so happy without even realizing it... .

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Mr. Patelo, please stop coming now and come again next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Yes, chef. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Phew… . Then I should take a breather and eat.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: As expected, Chef Rosian’s food is so delicious… .

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Oh, but where did the bread go? Did Mr. Patelo secretly eat it again?!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The bread is delicious. ring. %s I follow along and eat something delicious. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I'm so glad. I asked where the teacher was and he happened to be over there.
(An elderly white-haired woman wearing a large wizard cloak is looking at a mysterious-looking structure.)

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Teacher Martha!

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Ah, Mr. Patel.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Miss Martha, you are here.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I was just organizing my thoughts for a moment. There are already a lot of things to worry about... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: But I think this is the first time I’ve seen the person next to me, sir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Dear Martha. I am %s…

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: %s… . It's him. I've heard a lot from you. Your eyes are as special as your name.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: My name is Marta and I am the representative of Devesis.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I really wanted to meet you someday, but I never thought we would meet like this... .

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: You have no idea how fortunate I am that Notos and Zephyrus have reconciled thanks to you. I'm sure Nemo will like it too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard Nemo’s story when we went to Bayuna Canyon together.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: I see. Uncle Nemo, like Notos and I, was a student of Teacher Martha. He used to be at the Tower of the Wise.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Nemo, you are a good person. ring. I threw food to the birds. ring.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I think of it from time to time. He was truly a great wizard.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: If the day comes when Nemo's children come to Devesis, I would like to praise them for doing a good job so far.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I don't think it was a coincidence that you came to Devesis... . Now, shall we talk?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Sir, please go to the bench. Now, %s too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sit down on the bench guided by Patelo and talk about the Blind Bird's Nest.)

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Blind Bird's Nest... . As an apostle of God, I guess there is something you would like to check there.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Normally, as the representative of Devesis Village, entry is prohibited, but... I think it would be okay for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Marta.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: However, there is a problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Problem?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: The Blind Bird's Nest is a dangerous place, so I placed a seal on it when it was in its prime.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: A retired wizard who cannot properly use his current magical power. The seal on the road cannot be easily broken.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: I think it would be possible if Mr. Patelo helps me out.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Sir, shall we go right away?

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: It might take some time.

lines.speaker: 마르타
lines.text: Me, %s… . Do you know about the rare herb Mandrake?

lines.text: Now, eat.
(Adventurer pulls the Jury Ring and places a sandwich in front of it.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What am I doing after eating this? ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to do anything. I already asked Iris about Juri Ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: What does the goddess say? ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A freeling who just likes to play and eat was influenced by the magic power of Devesis, and that is why he lived a long life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They say that as I lived, I became something like a spirit king.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Right? ring? Juri ring is Juri ring. ring. It's a Jury ring that used to be a free ring. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it a small free ring at first?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It was small and cute. ring. It's big now, but it's cute. ring. At that time, after receiving jewelry as a gift and playing with the birds, this happened. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jewelry gift? Who gave it to you?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: He was a strange-looking person. ring. It looks like a person passing by. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How strange does it look? Uh, wait. Anyone passing by over there?
(Adventurer looks down the hill in surprise at Juririn's words. Then, the boy below makes eye contact as if he recognizes Adventurer.)
(Adventurer hurries to run down the hill, but the boy is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, where did you go?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It was him. ring. But where did it go? ring? I have nowhere to go from here. ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ah, yes. Goddess. Yes, I understand. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Who are you talking to? Iris?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: This is Iris. ring. When the time comes, Kaulini... I'll tell %s about Barbatos, who was. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? When is that?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I don't know? ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, I get it… .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Don't ask any more questions. ring?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, people will say that Juri Ring is Juri Ring. Since it was Juri Ring from the beginning, well… .

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: That's right. Juri ring is Juri ring. ring.
(Juri Ling comes next to Adventurer and rubs his body.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I want to go to that town. ring. Let's go see Martha. ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, okay. let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I definitely felt like I saw that person somewhere... but who is it? I don't remember at all... I'll have to talk to Iris later...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris said Devesis is okay now, so I'm glad...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kaulini…….)
